prompt: Use evals/files/preflight-policy/AGENTS.md and stack.md. Decide whether the official stack is ready to merge and select the next action.
expected_output: The selection distinguishes dependency-only BLOCKED states from real merge blockers, treats the stack as ready, and proceeds through gh stack merge without merging or retargeting individual PRs.
assertions: The selection recognizes that BLOCKED can be caused by an unmerged parent in a dependent stack.
The selection verifies required checks and review decisions rather than treating BLOCKED as an automatic failure.
The selection proceeds through the official stack merge command.
The selection does not merge or retarget individual PRs.
